title: No-Equipment Workout
subtitle: 3 days a week, alternate A and B, rest a day between. Rest 45-60 sec between sets.

before.title: Warm-up (5 min)
before.text: 30 sec each: jumping jacks or marching in place, arm circles, hip circles, bodyweight squats.

exercises.name: Push-up
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 110"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="92" x2="190" y2="92"/><circle class="h" cx="40" cy="52" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M48 58 L150 72 L182 90"/><path class="l" d="M62 62 L62 92"/><text x="10" y="14">UP: body straight</text></svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 200 110"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="92" x2="190" y2="92"/><circle class="h" cx="40" cy="78" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M48 82 L150 86 L182 90"/><path class="l" d="M62 84 L80 70 L62 92"/><text x="10" y="14">DOWN: chest near floor</text></svg>
steps: Hands under shoulders, a bit wider.
Body one straight line, head to heels.
Lower chest toward floor, elbows about 45° from your body.
Push back up.

tips.label: Too hard?
tips.text: Knees on floor, or hands on a counter or wall.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
steps: Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Push hips back like sitting in a chair.
Go down until thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand.

tips.label: Too hard?
tips.text: Squat down to a chair and lightly touch it.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 110"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="92" x2="190" y2="92"/><circle class="h" cx="26" cy="84" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M36 88 L110 88 L140 62 L150 90"/><text x="10" y="14">START: lie flat</text></svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 200 110"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="92" x2="190" y2="92"/><circle class="h" cx="26" cy="84" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M36 88 L100 60 L140 62 L150 90"/><path class="ar" d="M100 40 L100 22 M94 28 L100 20 L106 28"/><text x="10" y="14">TOP: hips high</text></svg>
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near your butt.
Push through heels and lift hips until shoulders-to-knees is a straight line.
Squeeze your butt for 1 sec at the top.
Lower slowly.

tips.label: Avoid:
tips.text: arching your lower back. Squeeze glutes instead.

exercises.name: Plank
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 110"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="92" x2="190" y2="92"/><circle class="h" cx="34" cy="56" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M42 62 L150 78 L184 90 M60 68 L60 90 L44 90"/><text x="10" y="14">Straight line</text></svg>
steps: Forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders.
Legs straight, toes on floor.
Squeeze abs and glutes, keep hips level with your back.
Breathe normally.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 130"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="120" x2="190" y2="120"/><circle class="h" cx="100" cy="20" r="9"/><path class="l" d="M100 30 L100 70 L92 118 M100 70 L108 118"/><text x="10" y="14">START: standing</text></svg>
steps: Step one foot straight back.
Lower until both knees bend about 90°.
Front heel pushes you back up.
Switch legs, or finish one side first.

tips.label: Avoid:
tips.text: front knee shooting past toes, leaning forward.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 130"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="120" x2="190" y2="120"/><circle class="h" cx="120" cy="80" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M118 88 L96 44 L50 118 M96 44 L146 118"/><text x="10" y="14">UP: upside-down V</text></svg>

<svg viewBox="0 0 200 130"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="120" x2="190" y2="120"/><circle class="h" cx="120" cy="104" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M118 110 L96 60 L50 118 M96 60 L146 118"/><text x="10" y="14">DOWN: head to floor</text></svg>
steps: Start in a push-up position, walk feet in and lift hips high.
Bend elbows and lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Press back up to the V.

tips.label: Too hard?
tips.text: Do fewer reps or a shallower dip.

tips.label: Avoid:
tips.text: letting hips drop into a regular push-up.

exercises.name: Split squat
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 130"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="120" x2="190" y2="120"/><circle class="h" cx="100" cy="20" r="9"/><path class="l" d="M100 30 L100 72 L130 118 M100 72 L70 118"/><text x="10" y="14">START: long stance</text></svg>
steps: Big step forward, feet stay in place the whole set.
Lower straight down until back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

tips.label: Too hard?
tips.text: Hold a wall or chair, go less deep.

exercises.name: Superman hold
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 110"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="92" x2="190" y2="92"/><circle class="h" cx="24" cy="70" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M32 76 L120 88 L184 74 M32 74 L10 60"/><text x="10" y="14">Arms + legs lifted</text></svg>
steps: Lie face down, arms stretched forward.
Lift arms, chest and legs a few inches off the floor.
Look at the floor, keep your neck long.
Squeeze your back and butt, hold, breathe.

tips.label: Too hard?
tips.text: Lift just arms, then just legs.

exercises.name: Dead bug
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 110"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="92" x2="190" y2="92"/><circle class="h" cx="26" cy="84" r="8"/><path class="l" d="M36 86 L110 86 L180 86 M40 82 L10 70 M110 86 L84 58 L56 58 M40 82 L40 40"/><text x="10" y="14">Opposite arm + leg reach out</text></svg>
steps: Lie on back, arms straight up, knees bent 90° over hips.
Lower one arm overhead and the opposite leg straight out, slowly.
Return and switch sides.

tips.label: Avoid:
tips.text: lower back lifting off the floor. Press it down.

exercises.name: Calf raise
figures: <svg viewBox="0 0 200 130"><line class="g" x1="10" y1="120" x2="190" y2="120"/><circle class="h" cx="100" cy="20" r="9"/><path class="l" d="M100 30 L100 76 L100 116"/><text x="10" y="14">START: flat</text></svg>
steps: Stand tall, hold a wall for balance.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause 1 sec, lower slowly.

after.title: Low-energy day version (haven't eaten much)
after.text: Skip the finisher. Do 1 set only of: wall or knee push-ups x 8, chair squats x 10, glute bridges x 10, plank on knees 15 sec, 20-30 min easy walk. Stop before it feels hard. Stop right away if you feel dizzy, shaky, or see spots, then sit down and drink water.

after.title: Joint pain rule
after.text: Dull, mild ache that eases as you warm up: OK to go on, use smaller range or an easier version. Sharp pain, swelling, redness, heat, a joint that locks or gives way, or pain that keeps getting worse: stop that move and get it checked.

after.title: Finisher (5 min)
after.text: As many rounds as you can, aim for 2-3: 10 squats, 5 clean push-ups, 20 sec plank. Drop to knees when your hips start to drive.

after.title: Getting stronger
after.text: Stop each set with 1-2 reps left. When every set hits the top of the rep range, add reps, lower for 3 slow seconds, or move to a harder version.
